Deployment & Integration (cloud and edge, client environments)

bullets.text: Developed a ROS2-based robotic system in Python, integrating a simulator and MPC controller for precise obstacle avoidance and full trajectory completion with real-time state logging.

edits.before: Developed a ROS2-based robotic system integrating a simulator and MPC controller, enabling precise obstacle avoidance and full trajectory completion with real-time state logging.
edits.after: Developed a ROS2-based robotic system in Python, integrating a simulator and MPC controller for precise obstacle avoidance and full trajectory completion with real-time state logging.
edits.reason: Added 'in Python' to align with JD keyword; changed 'enabling' to 'for' for clarity. Factual claim preserved.

bullets.text: Integrated OptiTrack motion capture with the robotic platform, achieving <1 mm position accuracy and <10 ms latency for closed-loop pose control in indoor environments.

edits.before: Integrated OptiTrack motion capture system with robotic platform, achieving <1 mm position accuracy and <10 ms latency, supporting real-time position feedback for closed-loop control in indoor environments.
edits.after: Integrated OptiTrack motion capture with the robotic platform, achieving <1 mm position accuracy and <10 ms latency for closed-loop pose control in indoor environments.
edits.reason: Condensed for brevity while preserving integration + accuracy claims.

bullets.text: Applied control system design and experimental validation to establish an OptiTrack-based real-time feedback pose control system, enabling sub-centimeter trajectory tracking and iterative controller refinement.
Led a 5-member cross-functional team to develop a hybrid flying-driving robot platform, achieving 100% integration of mobility and flight subsystems.
Developed embedded C firmware for STM32F407, enabling CAN-based motor control, BLE remote communication, and PID position control with +/-2 mm tracking error for an omnidirectional mobile robot.
Implemented a custom UART protocol with headers, footers, and float unpacking; leveraged DMA + interrupts for non-blocking 100 Hz updates of 6-DoF data, with <0.2% error rate.

edits.reason: Replaced banned verb 'used' with 'leveraged'. Factual claim preserved.

bullets.text: Modularized the robot into gimbal, power, launcher, and chassis subsystems to achieve independent functionality and decoupled operation, incorporating modular interfaces and redundancy to improve system stability and debuggability.

edits.before: Modularized the robot into gimbal, power, launcher, and chassis to achieve independent functionality and decoupled operation, incorporating modular interfaces and redundancy to improve system stability and debuggability.
edits.after: Modularized the robot into gimbal, power, launcher, and chassis subsystems to achieve independent functionality and decoupled operation, incorporating modular interfaces and redundancy to improve system stability and debuggability.
edits.reason: Added 'subsystems' for clarity. Factual claim preserved.

bullets.text: Oversaw part sourcing, assembly, testing and iteration under DFA principles; delivered two autonomous launch platforms and one joystick-controlled quadruped within strict fabrication deadlines.

Designed a compact, low-power crane system with ESP32-based Wi-Fi remote control, enabling low-latency communication and autonomous coordination across multiple devices, achieving over 95% task repeatability.

Consolidated five functional boards into a single 4-layer PCB with KiCad, integrating control, power, and communication modules; reduced overall footprint by 40% and verified signal integrity via 100-MHz oscilloscope.
Integrated a line-following module to enable autonomous navigation in semi-structured environments, reducing manual intervention by 40% and improving coordination among multiple units.
Reviewed and debugged Siemens S7-1200 PLC programs submitted by a third-party integrator; verified and validated the full automation workflow for surface defect detection of large flat materials.
Integrated sensors including IR, microswitches, and pressure transducers to monitor system state and trigger alarms, enhancing operational reliability and safety.

edits.before: Integrated sensors like IR, microswitches, and pressure transducers to monitor system state and trigger alarms. Enhanced both system operational reliability and safety.
edits.after: Integrated sensors including IR, microswitches, and pressure transducers to monitor system state and trigger alarms, enhancing operational reliability and safety.
edits.reason: Combined two sentences into one for conciseness. Replaced 'like' with 'including' for precision. Factual claim preserved.
